name: Camunda
description: Business process automation and workflow engine for orchestrating back-office processes.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: "jdbc:postgresql://{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/camunda"
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: camunda
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_DRIVER_CLASS_NAME: org.postgresql.Driver
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: {{env.SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: camunda
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: camunda
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
